sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Pavi

lines.text: The bird knows both yards. I bring the water and change the harness at the end. The carriage only follows.
A harness comes loose at the yard. A working bird should not spend its rest pulling against the carriage.
You have looked long enough to see what we were trying to keep. That changes the conversation.
